triggers.detailsText: Choice International Limited Reports Strongest Quarter in its History, Clocking ₹379 Crore in Consolidated Revenue  The Board of Directors has recommended the issuance of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:1, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company.  Consolidated net profit rose to Rs 69.47 crores in Q2FY27, increasing 23% YoY , with a PAT margin of 18.3%.  Consolidated EBITDA stands at Rs 130.63 crores, while maintaining a margin of 34.5%.
filingKeyFacts: Choice International Limited Reports Strongest Quarter in its History, Clocking ₹379 Crore in Consolidated Revenue  The Board of Directors has recommended the issuance of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:1, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company.

 Consolidated EBITDA stands at Rs 130.63 crores, while maintaining a margin of 34.5%.
